title: HCL Technologies Ltd - 532281 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: HCLTech Q1 FY27 revenue $3,650M, down 0.5% QoQ but up 2.6% YoY in constant currency; record Q1 net new TCV of $2.4B; FY27 guidance held at 1-4%.
summary.overview: Q1 FY27 was seasonally weak sequentially, with revenue down 0.5% QoQ and EBIT margin at 16.9% (up 39 bps QoQ, helped by lower restructuring). Services grew 3.5% YoY, with ITBS up 4.2% and ER&D up only 0.3% YoY after a 3.7% QoQ decline. Net new TCV of $2.4B was the highest ever Q1, excluding a mega deal signed in early July. Management kept FY27 organic guidance of 1-4% revenue and 17.5-18.5% margin, and announced entry into AI datacenters with an up to INR3,500 crore initial investment.

financial_highlights.change: Highest ever Q1; excludes early-July mega deal
+4.5% QoQ; +6.9% YoY; INR64.25 including Labour Code one-time impact

segments.name: IT and business services
segments.commentary: Grew 4.2% YoY and was flat QoQ in constant currency, despite seasonal weakness and telecom client headwinds.

segments.name: Engineering and R&D services
segments.commentary: Grew 0.3% YoY but fell 3.7% QoQ, driven by Tech and Telecom and Media & Entertainment; management attributed it to discretionary cuts at two large US telcos and a high base in tech.

segments.name: HCL Software
segments.commentary: Revenue $313M, up 2.2% QoQ but down 5.3% YoY; ARR $1.063B, up 2% YoY. Jaspersoft acquisition completed in early July adds a visualization layer to the data portfolio.

guidance_outlook: FY27 organic revenue growth guidance retained at 1% to 4% in constant currency; not raised despite strong Q1 bookings, as the band is broad and only one quarter has passed.
FY27 EBIT margin guidance retained at 17.5% to 18.5%, including approximately 40-50 bps of restructuring cost.
Guidance excludes acquisitions. Jaspersoft is expected to add roughly $10-15M per quarter of revenue from Q2 with seasonality; CTG acquisition expected to close later in Q2.
Mega deal (signed early July, Europe-headquartered Fortune Global 50 digital workplace) transition to start in a couple of months; steady state by April 2027; negligible FY27 revenue impact.
Management will revisit guidance after Q2 if directional change is warranted; macro view unchanged since March.
Medium-term FY28 margin guidance to be given with FY28 guidance next year; no medium-term margin band reiterated on this call.
capex_capacity: Initial investment of up to INR3,500 crore in an AI datacenter business, with potential to scale to 50 MW of capacity over the long term.

Investment to be staged and funded from free cash flow; possible funding via silicon/OEM partners, committed client capacity, hardware financing against contracted demand, and a mix of equity and debt.
Management in advanced discussions with clients to secure committed consumption from day one; part of capacity to be consumed internally in managed services and outcome-based contracts.
Strategic investment of $150M in Sarvam (Indian sovereign AI company) to build a full-stack sovereign AI platform for government and enterprises.
demand_pricing: Net new TCV $2.4B, highest ever Q1, well balanced across verticals, service lines and geographies; a Fortune 250 semiconductor equipment OEM signed for SAP-enabled design-to-manufacturing transformation.
Advanced AI revenue $171M, up 10.6% QoQ and 62.1% YoY. AI Force deployed across 92 client accounts.
Growth led by Public Services (+12% YoY) and Retail & CPG (+10.1% YoY); six of seven verticals grew YoY. Added one $100M client, six $50M, 11 $20M and 31 $10M clients YoY.
Geography YoY: USA +2.9%, Europe +0.1%, ROW +10.8%, India +16.9%.

BFSI growth attributed to AI-native approach and wallet share gains with top financial services clients; Life Sciences and Healthcare declined on lapse of medical device regulatory work and US healthcare stress.

Management sees divergence: AI-native and AI-amplified services growing strongly, AI-disrupted commoditized work being optimized further by automation. Revenue per employee up 3.3% YoY, rising for five consecutive quarters.

qa_highlights.question: What limits raising guidance given record Q1 bookings and the early-July mega deal?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the band is broad and only Q1 is done; the mega deal transitions over a couple of months with steady state only by April 2027 and negligible FY27 revenue impact.

qa_highlights.question: Why does the AI datacenter investment look like a colocation-cost build (about $7M per MW), and what further commitments follow?
qa_highlights.answer: INR3,500 crore is only an initial fraction of the long-term 50 MW plan; it is a full-stack play, not colocation, with further investment tied to free cash flow and funded via partners, client commitments, hardware financing, and equity/debt mix.

qa_highlights.question: Token costs: will they collapse or stay high, and what does that mean for services revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said token prices may fall but total token consumption will rise, so total cost rises; tiered architecture with enterprise SLMs creates a new engineering services wave in data work and training.

qa_highlights.question: Will margins return to 18-19% soon, perhaps in FY28?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said FY26 margins were near 18% excluding restructuring; FY27 guidance is 17.5-18.5% including 40-50 bps restructuring; FY28 margin guidance will be given next year.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the ER&D decline and will it continue?
qa_highlights.answer: Decline was in Tech and Telecom and Media & Entertainment, from sharp discretionary cuts at two large US telcos flagged last quarter, plus a high base in tech; no explicit outlook for further declines was given.

qa_highlights.question: Why enter datacenters now, and how does this differ from the cloud cycle? Also, what about GPU oversupply risk?
qa_highlights.answer: Management argued private AI stacks and SLMs differ from the cloud cycle, that megawatts are an anchor and value lies in wrapped services, and that the market remains GPU-starved; no explicit utilisation or tenancy assumptions were given.

qa_highlights.question: Does the margin guidance include amortization from M&A, and is the services outlook tougher than at the start of the quarter?
qa_highlights.answer: Guidance is organic and excludes acquisitions including Jaspersoft and CTG; macro view is unchanged since March and management will revisit after Q2.

qa_highlights.question: How big will Jaspersoft be, and when does CTG close?
qa_highlights.answer: Jaspersoft is expected to add about $10-15M per quarter with seasonality, consolidated from Q2; CTG expected to close later in Q2.

risks_watch: Revenue guidance (1-4%) was held despite the strongest Q1 bookings; any Q2 change in tone is flagged by management as possible after Q2 results.
ERS revenue is under pressure from telecom and media discretionary cuts; further sequential declines are possible.
AI datacenter entry (INR3,500 crore initial, 50 MW long-term) carries capex, funding and utilisation risk; no committed-consumption figures or return metrics were disclosed.
Margin pressure from AI investment and restructuring (40-50 bps in FY27); FY28 margin view deferred.
Declining healthcare and life sciences revenue, with management attributing it to regulatory work ending and US healthcare stress.
Telecom client headwinds and a high-tech base effect; attrition 12.7% LTM and headcount down 3,292 QoQ.
Pending CTG acquisition closing and Jaspersoft integration; guidance excludes both.
summary.management_tone: Confident on bookings, AI revenue growth and ROIC, but cautious on near-term services momentum: guidance was held rather than raised, with management citing a broad band and one quarter of data. Answers on datacenter economics and funding were detailed on strategy but light on quantified returns, utilisation or capex beyond the INR3,500 crore initial tranche.
key_quotes: Net new TCV booking for the quarter was $2.4 billion, highest ever Q1 bookings.
So we are not putting this entire investment in the balance sheet in a single year.
The guidance is organic growth guidance and does not include acquisitions including Jaspersoft.
Our strategy continues to be to deliver superior growth at stable margins.

adds.what: AI datacenter business: up to INR3,500 crore initial investment, potential to scale to 50 MW long term

growth.why: FY27 organic revenue guidance of 1% to 4% constant currency (midpoint 2.5%) was held, not raised; backing is a record Q1 TCV of $2.4B and Advanced AI revenue up 62.1% YoY, but no specific capacity or contract figures tie to the revenue band, and the AI datacenter capacity is 50 MW long term with no timeline.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Reported EBIT margin 16.9% (+39 bps QoQ) with restructuring at 62 bps in Q1, but FY27 guidance of 17.5-18.5% includes 40-50 bps of restructuring and FY28 margin view is deferred, so expansion depends on restructuring rolling off and AI datacenter startup costs.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Up to INR3,500 crore initial AI datacenter investment with potential to scale to 50 MW long term, but no timeline, utilisation or committed-consumption figures were disclosed; Jaspersoft and CTG are acquisitions, not capacity.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: FY27 organic revenue guidance held at 1-4% (midpoint 2.5%) with Q1 revenue down 0.5% QoQ, ERS down 3.7% QoQ and USA only +2.9% YoY; record $2.4B Q1 TCV and Advanced AI revenue of $171M (+62.1% YoY) support growth, but mega deal impact is negligible in FY27.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Management is in advanced discussions with clients for committed consumption from day one and says investment will be staged and funded from free cash flow, with 50 MW long-term potential against an initial INR3,500 crore tranche; further tranches tied to commitments.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Guidance was held rather than raised despite record Q1 TCV of $2.4B, with management citing a broad 1-4% band and only one quarter done; mega deal has negligible FY27 revenue impact and macro view unchanged since March.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Management said it will revisit guidance after Q2 if directional change is warranted; ERS fell 3.7% QoQ on US telco discretionary cuts, and Life Sciences/Healthcare declined on regulatory work lapse and US healthcare stress.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Jaspersoft acquisition completed early July adds a visualization layer to HCL Software's portfolio (ARR $1.063B, +2% YoY), and AI Force is deployed across 92 client accounts with Sarvam sovereign AI platform ($150M strategic investment) in build.

rows.label: Record Q1 net new TCV of $2.4B plus early-July mega deal
rows.why: TCV of $2.4B was the highest Q1 ever, and the mega deal signed in early July transitions over a couple of months to steady state by April 2027, though with negligible FY27 revenue impact.

rows.label: CTG acquisition closing later in Q2; Jaspersoft consolidated from Q2
rows.why: Jaspersoft expected to add roughly $10-15M per quarter of revenue from Q2 with seasonality, and CTG is expected to close later in Q2; both are excluded from organic guidance.

rows.label: Restructuring cost rolling off
rows.why: Restructuring cost was 62 bps in Q1 (EBIT 16.9% reported vs 17.5% ex-restructuring) and FY27 guidance includes 40-50 bps total, so the drag may ease as programs finish.

tone.note: Management was confident on record TCV, Advanced AI revenue (+62.1% YoY) and ROIC, but cautious on near-term services momentum and held guidance; analysts pushed on datacenter economics, utilisation and capex funding, and management gave strategy but few quantified returns.
